mentions.name: Postgres native UUID-derivation function
mentions.description: A Postgres native function that derives UUIDs from an integer primary key using AES intrinsics, allowing public UUID keys to be exposed while the database keeps using an efficient 64-bit sequential primary key.
mentions.problem: Exposing public UUID keys without giving up the efficiency of a 64-bit sequential primary key.
mentions.source_excerpt: Today I'm writing a Postgres native function to derive UUIDs from an integer primary key using AES intrinsics. This lets me expose public UUID keys while still using an efficient 64-bit sequential primary key.

evidence.value: Today I'm writing a Postgres native function to derive UUIDs from an integer primary key using AES intrinsics. This lets me expose public UUID keys while still using an efficient 64-bit sequential primary key.
